instruction: Using Visual Studio Code, create a Python script named `covid_global_cases_analysis.py` in the `/home/user/analysis_results/covid_data/` directory. In this script, load the global table from `https://www.worldometers.info/coronavirus/` (the “Countries where Coronavirus has spread” section), and extract the following fields for each country: `country`, `total_cases`, `total_deaths`, `total_recovered`, and `population`. Then compute `cases_per_million = (total_cases / population) * 1_000_000`. Identify the top 5 countries by highest `cases_per_million` and save the full table with the computed column to `covid_country_summary.csv` in the same directory with columns: `country`, `total_cases`, `total_deaths`, `total_recovered`, `population`, `cases_per_million`. Also save a text file named `covid_top5_cases_per_million.txt` containing exactly one line formatted as: `Top5_By_Cases_Per_Million: <country1>,<country2>,<country3>,<country4>,<country5>`.
